reviews.concern: Remote hosting has provider bandwidth limits; managed remote component is currently Windows x64 only.

reviews.concern: Several provider quota APIs have no public schema; the README notes parsing may surface missing-field diagnostics.

reviews.concern: Prerelease plugin; follow-up edits require an open editor, inactive pages need the canvas, and caches lack retention policy.

reviews.evidence: README lists runtime inject/uninject, host+UI reload, directory watch, persisted recovery, staging/promote tools, route cleanup, scaffolding, build/pack/release, and rollback.

reviews.evidence: Its own market behavior includes static-index discovery, search/categories, four installer types, material pauses, confirmations, installed/version detection, updates, backup, and logs.

reviews.concern: Guidance stops at install/config/start; chat, saves, uploads, and 33 slash commands lack an operating walkthrough.

reviews.evidence: Repository includes seven completed skills spanning GPU kernels, memory estimation, RL training, four diagram/slide systems, with install commands, example prompts, and gallery outputs.
reviews.concern: README warns content is heavily LLM-generated without strict proofreading; automated testing pipeline is still planned.

reviews.evidence: README shows a packaged DSH desktop with launcher/import, Git actions, file/diff/browser/agent sidebars, terminal, model controls, theming, extension management, tray, and recovery.
reviews.concern: macOS package is unsigned; upgrades need careful data import, and Intel Mac/Linux have no packaged release.

reviews.concern: Alpha and macOS-only; screenshots are not recorded, while event logs may capture typed text, URLs, paths, and private data.
